_about: The Island Edition's Quote of the Day (Nate, 2026-11-04: beach, saltwater, ocean, sailing themed). render.quote_section shows one a day, in turn by date. Only lines whose words and author are well established; a line the page trims is marked with an ellipsis, and the originals' dashes are written as commas or full stops. The routine never writes or edits this file. Checked 2026-11-04.

quotes.text: I know of a cure for everything: salt water ... Sweat, or tears, or the salt sea.
quotes.author: Isak Dinesen

quotes.text: And all I ask is a tall ship and a star to steer her by.
quotes.author: John Masefield

quotes.text: There is nothing, absolutely nothing, half so much worth doing as simply messing about in boats.
quotes.author: Kenneth Grahame

quotes.text: We are tied to the ocean. And when we go back to the sea, whether it is to sail or to watch it, we are going back from whence we came.
quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.text: The sea does not reward those who are too anxious, too greedy, or too impatient.
quotes.author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

quotes.text: The voice of the sea speaks to the soul.
quotes.author: Kate Chopin

quotes.text: Meditation and water are wedded for ever.
quotes.author: Herman Melville

quotes.text:
for whatever we lose(like a you or a me)
it's always ourselves we find in the sea
quotes.author: E. E. Cummings
quotes.work: maggie and milly and molly and may

quotes.text:
There is a pleasure in the pathless woods,
There is a rapture on the lonely shore
quotes.author: Lord Byron

quotes.text:
The sea! the sea! the open sea!
The blue, the fresh, the ever free!
quotes.author: Barry Cornwall
Jules Verne
quotes.work: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas (1870)

quotes.text: The three great elemental sounds in nature are the sound of rain, the sound of wind in a primeval wood, and the sound of outer ocean on a beach.
quotes.author: Henry Beston

quotes.text: The edge of the sea is a strange and beautiful place.
quotes.author: Rachel Carson

quotes.text:
To the Sea, to the Sea! The white gulls are crying,
The wind is blowing, and the white foam is flying.
quotes.author: J. R. R. Tolkien

quotes.text:
I started Early, Took my Dog,
And visited the Sea
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.text: A ship in harbor is safe, but that is not what ships are built for.
quotes.author: John A. Shedd

quotes.text: You sea! I resign myself to you also. I guess what you mean.
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.text:
Red sky at night, sailors' delight.
Red sky in morning, sailors take warning.
quotes.author: An old sailors' rhyme

quotes.text: Time and tide wait for no man.
quotes.author: An old proverb
